The image is a vertical magazine cover with a white background and a thick red border on the left. At the top, black text reads "KONTROVERSI KITAB FIKIH MUHAMMADIYAH". Below, the large word "TEMPO" is printed in a light green, serif font. A circular logo with stylized green shapes and the years "1971-2016" sits to the left. Under "TEMPO," the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appears in small, faint letters. A teal crescent moon and star are positioned to the right of the text "ISLAM JALAN DAMAI," which is written in bold black capital letters.

The lower half features a stylized illustration of several figures in teal, black, white, and tan. A central male figure with a mustache holds a teal book. To his right, a man in a black robe and white collar stands in profile. Below them, a man wearing a patterned head covering looks downward. On the far left, a figure in a white headscarf is shown. In the back, a light-tan domed structure with small windows stands to the right. Smaller teal text boxes with white text are located at the bottom left, including a barcode and the price "RP 39.500". A block of black text above the illustration reads: "BADAN ANTITEROR MENGUMUMKAN 19 PESANTREN TERINDIKASI RADIKAL. DI BELAHAN LAIN, SEJUMLAH PONDOK MEMASUKKAN TOLERANSI KE KURIKULUMNYA."
